summary: The Semantic Definition Format (SDF) lets domain experts describe data and interaction models for Things, meaning physical objects reachable over a network. An SDF specification defines objects and their properties, actions and events in a common format.

eli5.summary: This is a standard way to write a manual for a smart gadget, saying what it can tell you and what it can do, so different systems understand it.

questions: what is sdf semantic definition format
what is the sdf media type
subtitle: A JSON format for domain experts to describe what a networked Thing can report, do and announce.

tldr.problem: Many Internet of Things ecosystems each describe their devices in their own way, so a model written for one cannot easily be reused or converted for another.
tldr.mechanism: SDF is a JSON format with named groups for Objects, Things, Properties, Actions, Events and reusable Data types, plus a namespace and reference scheme so definitions can be shared and refined.
tldr.outcome: It gives domain experts one place to write protocol-independent interaction models, and leaves tools to convert them to other serializations and protocol bindings.

today: RFC 9880 is a Proposed Standard published in January 2026, and the unit metadata lists no RFC that obsoletes or updates it. It defines base SDF, with protocol bindings and other extensions left to companion documents.

sections.title: What SDF Is For
sections.content:
The Semantic Definition Format (SDF) is a format for domain experts to create and maintain data and interaction models that describe Things, meaning physical objects that are available for interaction over a network. An SDF specification describes definitions of SDF Objects and SDF Things, their interactions (Events, Actions and Properties), and the data types exchanged in those interactions.

This document is the base specification, "base SDF". It is designed to be extensible: extensions can add refinements such as protocol bindings for specific ecosystems. Base SDF defines no version concept for the format itself, relying on extension points and a features indication instead. Tools convert SDF to database formats and other serializations as needed.
sections.eli5: Think of a toy robot's instruction card that lists what it can do and what it can tell you. SDF is a shared way of writing that card so every toy shop reads it the same way.

sections.title: The Six Building Blocks
sections.content:
SDF models are built from six Class Name Keywords: sdfObject, sdfThing, sdfProperty, sdfAction, sdfEvent and sdfData. The first two are Groupings. The next three are affordances, the parts of a Thing's network interface that are offered for interaction. The last holds reusable data definitions.

An sdfObject is the main reusable "atom". It holds Property, Action and Event declarations and cannot nest other Groupings. The RFC suggests keeping Objects narrow, for example separate Objects for on/off control, dimming and color control of a light bulb. Setting minItems or maxItems turns an Object into an array of its affordances.

A Property models state that can be read, written or observed. An Action models a command, roughly like a method call, and may be long-running. An Event models something that happened and may be communicated proactively. sdfData definitions are not affordances themselves; they factor out data types that Properties, Actions and Events reuse. An sdfThing can contain nested sdfObjects and sdfThings, so it can describe a complex product.

Base SDF models what data means and how it is constrained. It does not define the payload formats or protocol settings for messages. Those are left to protocol bindings.
sections.eli5: A smart lamp has things it remembers (is it on?), things you can tell it to do (toggle), and things it can shout about (bulb broke). SDF has a word for each, plus a box for shared rules.

sections.title: Structure of an SDF Document
sections.content:
An SDF document is a single JSON map with three blocks. The optional information block (info) carries metadata such as title, description, version, modified, copyright, license and features. The features list names critical extensions that must be understood to process the definitions. Validators are RECOMMENDED to warn when there is no information block.

The namespaces block has a namespace map from short names to namespace URIs and a defaultNamespace that picks one of them. Without a default namespace, a document contributes nothing to the global namespace and its definitions stay local.

The definitions block holds at most one group per Class Name Keyword. Keys inside a group, such as Switch, are Given Names chosen by the author. Keys defined by SDF, such as type, are Quality Names. In a path down the tree the two roughly alternate. Entries in sdfProperty, sdfAction and sdfEvent inside an sdfObject or sdfThing are declarations, while entries in sdfData are only definitions.
sections.eli5: Every SDF file has a title page, an address book, and the actual list of parts. The names you pick yourself, like Switch, sit next to the fixed words SDF already knows.

sections.title: Names, Namespaces and Reuse
sections.content:
Global names look like https:// URIs with a fragment. The fragment is a JSON Pointer as in RFC 6901, selecting the defined element. The URIs do not have to be dereferenceable. In the RFC's Switch example, the action on becomes https://example.com/capability/cap#/sdfObject/Switch/sdfAction/on.

References use CURIE-style prefixes from the namespace map. A reference to something in the same document starts with the hash sign and continues with a JSON Pointer. Given Names with embedded colons are reserved and MUST NOT be used.

The keyword sdfRef copies the qualities and nested definitions of another definition into a new one. Other members next to it override or add to the copy. Formally, the map is treated as a patch applied with JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7396) to the referenced definition, so a null removes a member. Chains of sdfRef MUST be processed too, and a model with all of them processed is a resolved model. By convention, overrides should only further restrict the allowed values.

sdfRequired lists the declarations that are mandatory in a Grouping. It accepts JSON Pointers, plain names such as currentTemperature, or the Boolean true meaning the item carrying it is mandatory.
sections.eli5: Every part gets a full address, like a street name plus a house number. You can also copy a part someone else drew and change a few details, like photocopying a floor plan and erasing one room.

sections.title: Data and Interaction Qualities
sections.content:
All definitions share the common qualities description, label, $comment, sdfRef and sdfRequired. Properties and sdfData add data qualities, many inspired by json-schema.org (Appendix C of the RFC lists them). SDF's own include unit, nullable, contentFormat, sdfType, sdfChoice and enum.

A Property adds readable, writable and observable, each defaulting to true. An Action has sdfInputData and sdfOutputData; an Event has sdfOutputData. To pass several parameters, a data item of type object can combine them.

The unit quality SHOULD use names from the SenML Units or Secondary Units registries (RFC 8428, RFC 8798). If none fits, a URI may be used, and a colon tells a URI from a registered name. contentFormat follows RFC 9193.

sdfChoice offers named alternatives and replaces both the JSON Schema enum and anyOf. The enum keyword stays as shorthand for text-string choices. sdfType adds types beyond JSON's; base SDF defines byte-string (base64url without padding) and unix-time (a number holding POSIX time).
sections.eli5: For each part you can add notes like "this is measured in meters", "you can only look, not touch", or "pick one of these three choices".

sections.title: Composing Larger Models
sections.content:
The composition requirements include building products and product types from atomic sdfObjects, enriching a base definition with product-specific values such as unit or range, and referring to one part of a model from another. The examples are an outlet strip with a single plug unit made of on/off control, energy monitor and optional dimmer, and a refrigerator-freezer.

An sdfThing can contain sdfObjects, other sdfThings, sdfData and its own affordances, such as an on/off status for a whole refrigerator-freezer. Like an sdfObject, it becomes an array when minItems or maxItems is present. Paths in a namespace follow the JSON Pointers of the contributing documents, for example ns:#/sdfObject/Switch/sdfAction/on.

Reuse through sdfRef can produce an invalid result if the referenced definition holds something not valid in the new place, such as an sdfThing added inside an sdfObject.
sections.eli5: Small building blocks, like a plug or a freezer door, snap together into bigger things like a whole outlet strip or a fridge-freezer.

sections.title: IANA Registrations
sections.content:
IANA registered the media type application/sdf+json (file extension .sdf.json) and the CoAP Content-Format ID 434 for it. It also registered the URN sub-namespace urn:ietf:params:unit for unit names, though those URNs MUST NOT be used in a unit quality except where the unit name contains a colon.

A new registry group, "Semantic Definition Format (SDF)", holds four registries. SDF Quality Names and sdfType Values use Specification Required. SDF Quality Name Prefixes uses Expert Review and starts empty. SDF Feature Names uses Specification Required and starts empty. Prefixes let organizations define extension qualities written as a prefix, a colon and a name.
sections.eli5: The standard also asked for official name tags and ID numbers so that everyone uses the same labels for SDF files and extensions.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content:
Because SDF is JSON, implementations need to be robust against invalid or unpredictable input, preferably rejecting it. Attacker-controlled input can also cause performance problems, including through the regular expressions in pattern.

The main concern is trust in models. SDF may be used to validate data and to augment data with information from models. Implementations need to establish the provenance, authenticity, integrity and applicability of each model, including every component they compose. The RFC compares this to introducing source code into a build and warns of supply-chain attacks. A model that is quietly changed by an upgrade could weaken input validation, and augmentation could produce false data.

The specification does not define model discovery, access control for models or selective disclosure; it leaves those to future work such as protocol mappings.
sections.eli5: If you follow a recipe card from a stranger, you should check who wrote it. A tampered SDF model can trick a program the same way.

items.title: sdfThing
items.text: A Grouping that can nest sdfObjects and other sdfThings.

items.title: sdfObject
items.text: The reusable atom holding Properties, Actions and Events; no nesting.

items.title: sdfProperty
items.text: State that can be read, written or observed.

items.title: sdfAction
items.text: A command or method with optional input and output data.

items.title: sdfEvent
items.text: A happening reported with output data.

items.title: sdfData
items.text: Reusable data definitions; not affordances themselves.
